scenes.narration: Why do gamers now bring Nvidia only about 7 cents of every sales dollar?
Because data centers took over. Nvidia's revenue hit 215.9 billion dollars in fiscal 2026, up 65 percent.
Data centers brought in 193.7 billion. Gaming brought in 16 billion.
In the last quarter alone, data centers made 62.3 billion. That's almost four years of gaming sales.
And after making its chips, Nvidia keeps about 71 cents of every dollar.
